title: Add blocked chain alert system
documentation: Add high-signal alerts for blocked dev-bot chains (PR merge conflicts, stuck tasks >60min, review escalations). Alerts should appear prominently in the intervention panel and persist until resolved. Focus on actionable alerts only - no analytics.
acceptanceCriteria: Alert appears when chain is blocked for >60 minutes
Alert shows blocker reason (merge conflict, gate failure, etc)
Alert dismisses when blocker is resolved
Alert count badge in UI header

title: Add manual intervention controls to chain panel
documentation: Add intervention controls to ChainStatusPanel: skip gate, retry task, update base branch, escalate to human. Each action should require confirmation and log the intervention reason. UI should be minimal and action-focused.
acceptanceCriteria: Skip gate button with confirmation modal

title: Add queue pause/resume controls
documentation: Add manual queue management controls to DevBotsLayout: pause queue (stops new task processing), resume queue, clear specific queue type (task/pr/review). Include confirmation for destructive actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Pause button stops new task processing
Action logs include operator name and reason

title: Add chain drill-down modal
documentation: Add minimal chain details modal: PR link, blocker reason, task history (last 5 tasks), quick actions. Modal should be keyboard accessible (Esc to close). Focus on intervention, not analytics.
acceptanceCriteria: Modal opens from chain row click
Shows PR link (opens in new tab)
Shows current blocker with clear reason

title: Add task retry with context preservation
documentation: When retrying a failed task, preserve previous attempt's context (error logs, file changes attempted, failure reason). Pass context to new attempt so bot doesn't repeat same mistakes.
acceptanceCriteria: Failed task context saved to database
Retry includes previous context in prompt
Context includes: error logs, attempted files, failure reason
Bot acknowledges previous attempt in logs
Context preserved for up to 3 retry attempts

title: Add worker health monitoring to console panel
documentation: Enhance WorkerConsolePanel to show worker health: container status, last heartbeat, resource usage (CPU/memory). Alert when worker becomes unhealthy. Keep display minimal and actionable.
acceptanceCriteria: Red indicator when worker unhealthy (>5min no heartbeat)

title: Fix interactive session context not persisting
documentation: Interactive session context_snapshot column is not being updated during session. Context updates called but database not reflecting changes. Verify updateInteractiveContext method and database triggers.
acceptanceCriteria: Multiple context updates during session don't overwrite

title: Add session resume button to interactive tab
documentation: Add one-click session resume to InteractiveSessionTab. Show list of recent sessions (last 10) with context preview. Clicking resumes with previous context. Quick access to debugging ongoing issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Resume button starts new session with inherited context
Session list updates on new session start
